Architectual Visualisation: De Rotterdam by Architect Rem Koolhaas

Andy CASA, UCL East


De Rotterdam (by architect Rem Koolhaas) is one of the 7 new highrise buildings to be constructed in the next several years on the Wilhelminadock in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

This building will reach 135 meters, the other 6 (The Havana, The New Orleans, The Baltimore, The Chicago and The San Fransisco) will be up to 180 meters..

Embedded below is the obligatory visualization and its well produced, we especially like the opening cityscape:



For more information a look at the Office for Metropolitan Architecture, its not your 'standard' architecture website - well worth a look.
